messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: inference-api v2.3.0 -> staged rollout 5% prod us-east1. Release notes: https://redwood/internal/releases/2.3.0
matt (eng-release): ACK, monitoring dashboards up. will watch latency/errors. link to changelog?
deploy-bot: Release notes posted: https://redwood/internal/releases/2.3.0/notes
anna (eng-platform): quick heads-up — traffic profile shows more long-tail seq lengths than test. watching kv-cache OOM risk.
priya (sre): seeing a latency bump at p95 in us-east1: +9% in last 2m, error rate from model-serving increased to 0.7% (baseline 0.1%).
kevin (prodops): can you paste the query? I want to check recent autoscale events.
priya (sre): paste: `metric query: sum(rate(http_request_errors[1m])) by (instance)`
oncall-jen: also saw two 500s from model-host-3 ~2m ago, logs: `2024-11-21T10:07:12Z ERROR inference kvcache evict failed` -> suspect memory pressure
matt (eng-release): can we pause? what's impact to active requests? ops?
kevin (prodops): rollback is fastest: pin traffic back to v2.2.9 or hold at current. can do hold (stop new shifts) in 30s.
anna (eng-platform): recommend pause first, gather full trace. not yet rollback unless errors continue.
priya (sre): agreed — PAUSE rollout now. please confirm so deploy-bot can stop traffic shift.
matt (eng-release): STOP. pause rollout. tag: @deploy-bot stop-rollout 1935554321
deploy-bot: Received stop-rollout command. Holding staged shift. Current traffic: v2.3.0=5%, v2.2.9=95%. Paused at 1935554321
matt (eng-release): ok we'll run quick smoke + kv-cache check. Priya do you want me to pin v2.2.9 preemptively?
priya (sre): don't pin yet. capture traces for 15m, check p95 and errors across regions. if error rate >0.5% sustained -> rollback.
anna (eng-platform): starting gc/oom heap dump request on model-host-3. linking runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/kvcache-oom
kevin (prodops): I'm standing by to execute rollback if we hit the threshold. tag me with `@kevin rollback`.
matt (eng-release): noted. I'll update release notes channel and leave deploy ticket open.
matt (eng-release): if we need to roll, I'll pin v2.2.9 and cut a quick postmortem.
priya (sre): quick check: p50 stable, p95 trending up, errors at 0.6% now. this is borderline.
oncall-jen: recommendation: keep paused, start canary repro on staging-inc to attempt to reproduce.
kevin (prodops): ok if it spikes past 1% in next 10m I will execute rollback unless we see remediation.
deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged and alerting continued. Manual rollback required to revert traffic.
matt (eng-release): reconvene T+15m or sooner. if no improvement -> rollback and pin v2.2.9.
priya (sre): copying logs and traces to ticket PLAT-4823
matt (eng-release): thanks all. :thumbsup:
kevin (prodops): standing by. :eyes:
